quiz.question: What is Neo’s name outside his hacker identity?
quiz.explanation: Neo is the hacker identity of computer programmer Thomas Anderson.

quiz.question: Which pill does Neo take to uncover the truth about the Matrix?
quiz.explanation: Neo chooses the red pill and awakens outside the simulation.

quiz.question: What is the name of Morpheus’s hovercraft?
quiz.explanation: Morpheus rescues Neo aboard the Nebuchadnezzar.

quiz.question: Where have the remaining free humans established their refuge?
quiz.explanation: Zion is the underground refuge of the remaining free humans.

quiz.question: What are the Agents within the Matrix?
options: Holograms with no ability to act
quiz.explanation: The Agents are sentient programs that protect the simulation.
evidence_markers: sentient programs that protect the system

quiz.question: Which crew member betrays the team to return to the Matrix’s comforts?
quiz.explanation: Cypher betrays the team because he wants to return to the simulated life.

quiz.question: Who stops Cypher before he can kill Neo and Trinity?
quiz.explanation: Tank kills Cypher and extracts the surviving crew members.

quiz.question: What does Smith seek while interrogating Morpheus?
options: A launch code for the hovercraft
quiz.explanation: Smith wants Zion’s mainframe codes to help the machines destroy the resistance.

quiz.question: Who returns to the Matrix with Neo to rescue Morpheus?
quiz.explanation: Neo and Trinity re-enter the Matrix together to rescue Morpheus.

quiz.question: What disables the Sentinels as Neo escapes the Matrix?
options: The Oracle shutting down the simulation
quiz.explanation: The Nebuchadnezzar’s electromagnetic pulse disables the Sentinels.

facts.title: A 600-page visual pitch
facts.text: Geof Darrow and Steve Skroce created a 600-page storyboard showing the film shot by shot. It helped win studio approval.

facts.title: Four months before the cameras rolled
facts.text: The Wachowskis scheduled four months of training with martial-arts choreographer Yuen Woo-ping to prepare the cast for wire work.

facts.title: A rooftop with another movie’s history
facts.text: The rooftop set used for Trinity’s early escape was left over from Dark City.

facts.title: Almost fifty sounds for one pod
facts.text: Sound designer Dane A. Davis layered almost fifty sounds to create the sound of a human pod closing.

facts.title: Still cameras making a moving moment
facts.text: Bullet time used an array of cameras triggered fractions of a second apart, allowing slowed action while the viewpoint moved around it.
